boxMonEncryption.key: otId ^ personality, XORed into each u32 of BoxPokemon.secure.raw
boxMonEncryption.checksum: u16 sum of the 24 decrypted u16 halves of secure.raw
boxMonEncryption.substructOrder: index = personality % 24; substruct type t sits at secure.substructs[order[t][index]] (12 bytes each); from sSubstructOffsets
boxMonEncryption.nickname: 10 bytes in BoxPokemon.nickname + nickname11 and nickname12 in substruct 0
